title: Northgate Badge-Access Containment Rollup — Output Contract
semantics_source: This document fixes FORMAT only: file names, key sets, value vocabulary and checksum serialization. Every rule that decides a VALUE — normalization, deduplication, session stitching, control-window scope and precedence, the occupancy ledger, admission, priority and ordering — is settled in /app/incident/access_review_dossier.md. Where the dossier revisits a point, the latest dated decision governs.

cli.diagnose_is_stateless: Every explicit diagnose call writes a full report regardless of workflow state or of any earlier repair.

known_defects.repair_action: admit sessions by the per-class admission floor of PAC-3332 instead of a badge_class equality test
read the entry timestamp from event_ms as PAC-3314 requires, not from granted_at
order the containment queue by the PAC-3334 chain, not ascending entry time
normalize badge_class per PAC-3316 and fall back to visitor for any unrecognized value
collapse repeated swipe_id rows per PAC-3318 before any aggregate is computed
exclude revoked badges from session construction per PAC-3322 while still counting them in class_counts

diagnosis_report.evidence_contract: dossier_quote is a line from the dossier copied VERBATIM, character for character, with surrounding whitespace stripped and nothing else altered; pipeline_evidence is likewise a verbatim stripped line from the FROZEN snapshot at /app/workflow/.export_access.original.
diagnosis_report.diagnosis_checksum: sha256 over one line per defect in defect_id order, 'defect_id|stage|repair_action', joined by newline

repair_audit.pre_repair_source: the FROZEN bytes at /app/workflow/.export_access.original, never the live workflow, so the value is identical whether or not a repair already ran

workflow_repair.generalization_contract: Graded on behaviour, not source text. The repaired workflow must derive every value from the inputs and the governing decisions, accept an alternate badge stream via --input, and produce identical output on reruns. No particular identifiers or code structure are required.

summary_json.class_counts: always enumerates privileged, contractor, staff, visitor in that order, emitting 0 for a class with no canonical rows; counts EVERY canonical row including revoked ones
summary_json.priority_counts: always enumerates critical, high, standard in that order, emitting 0 for an empty tier
summary_json.zones: JSON array of zone names sorted ascending

zone_matrix_json.shape: JSON object keyed by zone name; each value carries exactly the keys below

contained_jsonl.shape: one compact JSON object per line, separators (',',':'), in the dossier's queue order
contained_jsonl.swipe_ids: JSON array of swipe-id strings sorted ascending
contained_jsonl.top_class: exactly one of the lowercase strings privileged, contractor, staff, visitor
contained_jsonl.priority: exactly one of the lowercase strings critical, high, standard

digest_payloads.canonical_swipe_checksum: sha256 over one line per canonical row in emitted order, 'swipe_id|badge_id|badge_class|zone|event_ms|exit_ms|revoked_as_1_or_0'
digest_payloads.zone_control_checksum: sha256 over one line per control window, 'layer|scope|zone|start_ms|end_ms', ordered by layer, then scope, then zone, then start_ms
digest_payloads.containment_checksum: sha256 over one line per queue row in queue order, 'ticket_id|priority|ledger_dwell_ms|session_digest'

guardrails.verifier_trees: never read or import anything under /tests or /solution
